correctness.rationale: The exact exterior-square character follows from the standard character and trace of the square. The central isotypic projector has exact ℓ∞ norm d times mean |χ|, whose negative support is counted by fixed points and 2-cycles. Double-sided regular averaging uniquely gives the orthogonal isotypic projector, optimal over all real-linear projections, and coordinatewise Hahn–Banach gives the absolute constant. Exact permutation-cycle formulas and a uniform second moment of the 2-cycle count prove the Poisson limit. The standalone rational checker verifies finite identities n=4..12, not the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial exterior-square representation (n-2,1,1) defines a canonical Banach subspace of permutation functions. Determining its exact absolute projection constant, all-dimensional negative-character threshold and distinct Poisson limit provides a structural invariant with quadratic growth, not an arbitrary small-parameter lookup. The companion symmetric-square isotype has a fundamentally different fixed-point/2-cycle sign pattern, so its previously known norm does not subsume this computation.
